findings.affected_surface: scripts/run-ledger.sh (atomic_append_ledger journal carry) alternative implementation shape in plan section 2.1
findings.claim: The plan offers two acceptable reference shapes, but the second one ('to_entries | group_by(.value._rotation_root) | map(min_by(.key)) | sort_by(.key) | map(.value)') uses group_by and sort_by on journal rows, which R4 explicitly forbids ('uses no sorting primitive (group_by, unique_by, sort_by, sort) on journal rows').
findings.evidence: Plan section 2.1 states 'Reference shape (either form is acceptable; both keep first occurrence and append order)' and then lists the reduce-based form followed by the to_entries/group_by/min_by/sort_by form. The frozen rubric R4 bans group_by, unique_by, sort_by, and sort on journal rows outright, not merely their order-destroying use.
findings.evidence_reference: PLAN_UNDER_REVIEW section 2.1, second reference jq; FROZEN_RUBRIC R4
findings.repair: Amend section 2.1 to present only the reduce-based carry as the accepted shape and mark the to_entries/group_by/sort_by variant as rejected because it violates R4's no-sorting-primitive constraint on journal rows, even though sort_by(.key) happens to restore index order.

findings.affected_surface: docs/BACKLOG.md version pin for the shipped row
findings.claim: The plan's version-pinning contingency (reseal with a freed number if an intervening release lands first) could ship the row under a version other than v2.36.54, which R9 pins exactly.
findings.evidence: Section 2.4 says 'canonical origin/develop is 2.36.53 at freeze — if an intervening release lands first, depth-0 reseals with the freed number per the concurrent-session rule', while R9 requires Status 'shipped v2.36.54' and the hetero-impl-loop step 11 entry to carry that version.
findings.repair: No current change; follow-up only. If resealing occurs, the depth-0 seal must update the version consistently across the BACKLOG row and the hetero-impl-loop step 11 entry in the same change so R9's single-version invariant still holds.

findings.affected_surface: scripts/run-ledger.sh journal-carry implementation and its Codex mirror
findings.claim: The plan explicitly permits an implementation that violates the frozen prohibition on sorting primitives for journal rows.
findings.evidence: Section 2.1 allows an alternative based on to_entries, group_by, min_by, and sort_by. R4 expressly forbids group_by, unique_by, sort_by, and sort on journal rows, regardless of whether a later index sort reconstructs append order.
findings.repair: Remove the sorting-based alternative from the plan and require the order-preserving reduce with a seen-root map and output array. Add an acceptance check scoped to the journal binding that rejects group_by, unique_by, sort_by, or sort while leaving the unchanged stage-carry grouping permitted.
